title: Complete one real Anth.us story through the pod
description:
# Complete one real Anth.us story through the pod

## Intent

As an Anth.us editor, I want one genuine post to complete the entire pod workflow, so that the design is tested under real research, judgment, revision, and publication consequences.

## Behavior specification

Feature: Operate a real story through a newsroom pod

Scenario: Publish a real Anth.us post
  Given a genuine Anth.us story idea has been selected
  And the newsroom pod, gates, doctrine, measurement capture, and publication check are ready
  When agents and the editor take the story from idea through publication using supported Kanbus transitions
  Then the published Anth.us article is generated from the approved pod source
  And every stage transition is present in Kanbus history
  And the run evidence distinguishes coaching, blocks, recoveries, false positives, and human interventions
  And the result states whether to proceed, revise, or stop
  And it makes no claim about external onboarding success

## Boundary

A dummy fixture may verify mechanics, but it cannot satisfy this story.
